items.reason: The Campo agency names the General Council of the Campo Band of Kumeyaay Indians. SCTCA independently uses that government name; the federal listing and saved BIA402 corroborate the identity. Broader Kumeyaay peoples and other governments remain distinct. The unavailable general government site is not marked verified.
The agency’s own account dates its creation by the Band’s General Council to July 1990. No present composition, jurisdiction ruling or U.S. EPA identity is inferred.
The account dates installation of erosion structures to 1992. It supplies no independently measured present stream flow, water quality or ecological condition.
The historical vote and effective date are attributed to the agency. Present land use, enforcement, income and environmental outcomes are not established.
The source dates the feature to summer 2026 and describes work with the named Garden. It establishes no measured conservation result or present funding.
